tools.name: make_signature
tools.description: Writes a name as a signature in one of 24 script styles, with name format, slant, size, underline, ink and natural hand. Returns the image as a transparent PNG and an SVG, plus a link to the same signature on Signature Maker.

tools.name: signature_styles
tools.description: Lists the 24 signature styles with the name written in each, filterable by elegant, casual or bold. Returns a picture of the name in every style and a link to open each style on Signature Maker.

tools.name: handwritten_signature
tools.description: Writes a name in six handwritten hand styles for each of three name formats, full name, initial and surname, and monogram, 18 versions in all. Returns a PNG picture and an SVG for each version.

tools.name: signature_ideas
tools.description: Gives ideas for opening a signature with the first capital letter of a name, A to Z: three ways to draw the capital, how to start and join it, and six hand styles shown on the name.

tools.name: signature_practice_sheet
tools.description: Makes a practice sheet for a name with six boxes to trace and six to write freehand. Returns a PDF on A4 or US Letter and a picture of the page.
